feeds.title: Hipster Spinster
feeds.description: Hipster Spinster is a personal blog managed by Victoria who is personal with multiple talents and interest. Her blog showcases her personal interest, hobbies, experiences and stories. The personal blog covers topics such as art, exhibition, writings, designs, music and more.

feeds.title: Spinsters Of San Francisco Blog
feeds.description: Spinsters of San Francisco (SOSF) is a social nonprofit of young professional women making a positive difference in the Bay Area through volunteering and fundraising. We believe that when a diverse and close group of ambitious women come together, we can accomplish great things for our community. Read our blog to learn more about our events, community people, fundraisers and information about our organization.

feeds.title: The Future Of Fear Is Female
feeds.description: The Spinsters of Horror, Jess (right) and Kelly (left), flew onto the horror scene in July 2018 to assist in filling the void of female voices in podcasting with their show I Spit on Your Podcast. On the podcast, we discuss horror, cult, and subversive movies with thoughtful analysis, research and passion. They also have a blog that covers their personal stories, experiences, podcast details, news and more.

feeds.title: Spinster Stitcher Blog
feeds.description: The Spinster Stitcher Blog is personal blog page f a lady where she post about her daily life, adventures, activities, the places she travels and more about the details about her life.

feeds.title: Spinster Life
feeds.description: Spinster Life or The Invisible Woman, random thoughts and musings.

feeds.title: The Spinsters' Book Blog
feeds.description: A dose of inspiration for women in want of a heroine - or of a lullaby to soothe their poor nerves. I will explore the works and life of one literary spinster per month, from Emily Brontë to Emily Dickinson, through a mix of in-depth analyses and podcast. Click to read The Spinsters' Book Blog, by Aida Vittoria Eltanin, a Substack publication.

feeds.title: Adventurous Kate
feeds.description: My name is Kate McCulley and I travel the world for a living. Her mission to show you that yes, it is possible for women to travel on their own and independently while staying safe and having the time of their lives.This is the ultimate guide to solo female travel and inspirational adventures around the world.

feeds.title: Spoiled Spinster Blog
feeds.description: Spoiled Spinster Blog is managed by a 30-year-old girl WHO STOPPED SETTLING FOR the ORDINARY AND STARTED CHASING the EXTRAORDINARY. In her blog, she talks about her personal life, various experiences, personal stories, travel journey, recipes, fashion and more stuff.

feeds.title: The Awkward Spinster
feeds.description: Fawn Kemble is a 40-something single Christian geek girl. A nerd from day one, she was born to Christian artists and teachers and spent her life trying to navigate the rough seas of the modern American church. She is a Library Associate and Storytime Lady at the city library by day, and a freelance counselor by night.

feeds.title: The Frugal Spinster
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Ari. I'm a cheapskate who's always hungry. I am mostly vegan. Most of these recipes will be, too. I created this blog to share my love of making my own food, saving money, and photography.

feeds.title: Spinster Sisters Blog
feeds.description: Spinster Sisters Blog is managed by the Founder, Kelly Perkins, who will get you inspired with stories and updates from our Microsoapery, and help you discover gift guides & more.

feeds.title: The Warped Spinster Blog
feeds.description: The Warped Spinster Blog is a personal blog managed by a middle-aged woman named Karen who enjoys knitting, spinning, and weaving, as well as other crafts and hobbies. The blog is about the author's experiences and thoughts related to her daily activities, as well as other topics related to her life and interests.
